name: com.moonshotlab1/inventory
title: Moonshot Lab (demo)
description: Agent car inventory index. Synthetic demo data, not real inventory, not an offer.

tools.name: search_inventory
tools.description:
Search the SYNTHETIC demo inventory (about 860 fictional vehicles at 20 fictional dealers in TX, CA, FL, GA, AZ,
IL, NY and OH). Results are not real vehicles for sale; say so when you show them.
Each result has listing_id (dealer_key:VIN), vehicle basics, headline_price (before tax, title and fees), dealer_name,
and selling_location: the store that holds the unit, with address and phone. link_status is linked, or ambiguous
when the listing does not say which of the dealer's stores holds it (see selling_location_candidates). A unit can
be held at a sister store run by another dealer in the same group; operated_by_dealer_id then differs from dealer_id.
Matching is exact on vocabularies, so a total of 0 often means a wrong value: check the parameter descriptions,
widen radius_miles or drop a filter; a zero total also returns hints.
The named parameters are shortcuts. filters reaches every other attribute: for example
{"field": "canonical.vin", "op": "eq", "value": "<VIN>"} finds a VIN, {"field": "price_summary.doc_fee", "op": "range",
"max": 300}, {"field": "incentives[].label_raw", "op": "eq", "value": "Military Appreciation"}.
Payment search: payment_max / payment_min filter on a DEMO monthly finance estimate computed per listing from its
itemized out-the-door estimate (tax, title, registration, dealer fees) for the buyer location, minus down payment and
trade equity, at a demo APR by credit tier unless apr is given. Each result then has estimated_payment (rounded to
$5, with a range) and dealer_advertised_payment when the listing shows one; the response has payment_assumptions
and a one-line assumptions_summary to read back to the shopper. For 'under $300/month' pass max_monthly_payment=300.
With a cap, near_misses lists up to 3 cars just above it, and a zero result returns to_reach_target (extra down
payment, or a 72 or 84 month term). To compare scenarios for one car, use compare_payment_scenarios.
Every result has estimated_out_the_door (exact, same as estimate_out_the_door for the buyer location), availability
(status, price_valid_until, last_updated, observed_at), seating_capacity, third_row and cargo_capacity_cu_ft
(synthetic demo specs). sort=best_value score = 0.35 * cost_score + 0.30 * age_score + 0.35 * mileage_score
(formula in best_value_formula). A zero result with zip returns coverage: nearest_store, nearest_new_inventory and
nearest_qualifying_inventory with distance, match count and lowest out the door, plus a coverage_note.
estimated_out_the_door on results and near_misses carries the same warnings and excluded_items (for example an
optional add-on's name and price) that estimate_out_the_door returns. Each result has group_id, region_id and store_id
(dealer hierarchy; also filterable) and dealer_segment / dealer_type,
third_row_type and sliding_doors. With payment inputs, estimated_payment has financing_eligibility, credit_tier and
credit_tier_source (default when not given), negative_equity_rolled_in, loan_to_value_pct and warnings; the response
has financing_summary. Pass financeable_only=true to drop listings the demo financing rules flag.
Decision attributes: every result has decision_attributes (demo-inventory attributes copied from public sources
for the year, make, model, trim and drivetrain: EV range, kWh/100 mi, Level 2 charge hours and DC fast-charge
port; pickup max towing and payload; NHTSA overall stars and driver-assist features; rear camera; seats and
cargo), with source ids and a not_available list. A null is never guessed. Filters: min_range_miles, charging,
min_tow_lbs, min_payload_lbs, min_seats, min_cargo_cuft, driver_assist, min_safety_stars; listings without a
sourced value are left out and counted in notes. EV results get energy_cost_per_mile only when you pass
electricity_price_per_kwh. get_listing shows each attribute's source documents and record links.
Estimate, not an offer; dealer sets price, lender sets rate. Not penny-accurate.

FieldFilter.description: One generic filter on any ontology field (see list_searchable_fields).

field.description: Dotted field path from list_searchable_fields, e.g. canonical.exterior_color.family, price_summary.doc_fee, incentives[].label_raw, store.name, payment.estimated_monthly. Shortcut names such as make, model, color, price, state also work.

value.description: Value for eq, contains, bool or exists.
value.title: Value

FieldFilter.title: FieldFilter

PaymentScenario.description: One what-if finance scenario. Omitted fields use the call's defaults ($0 down, 60 months, good credit).

credit_tier.description: Picks the demo APR when apr is omitted. Credit tiers (demo APR new / used): excellent about 720 and up (6.0% / 8.5%); good about 660 to 719 (7.5% / 11.0%); fair about 620 to 659 (11.5% / 16.0%); poor below about 620 (15.5% / 20.0%).
credit_tier.title: Credit Tier

trade_value.description: Trade-in allowance in USD (gets the state's trade-in tax credit).

payoff.description: Loan payoff owed on the trade-in, USD.

trade_equity.description: Net trade equity if allowance and payoff are unknown; no tax credit.
trade_equity.title: Trade Equity

eligible_incentive_labels.title: Eligible Incentive Labels

make.description: Make, case-insensitive, e.g. Honda, Ford, Tesla. 14 makes are present.

model.description: Model with its punctuation, case-insensitive: CR-V, F-150, Model 3, Mustang Mach-E.

dealer_key.description: Dealer key from list_dealers, e.g. lonemesa.
dealer_key.title: Dealer Key

price_min.description: Minimum headline price in USD (before tax, title and dealer fees).
price_min.title: Price Min

price_max.description: Maximum headline price in USD (before tax, title and dealer fees). For a budget that includes taxes and fees, check estimate_out_the_door.
price_max.title: Price Max

body_style.description: suv, sedan, pickup, hatchback, minivan or wagon. Use pickup for trucks.
body_style.title: Body Style

fuel_type.description: gasoline, hybrid, plug_in_hybrid or electric. Use electric for EV or BEV.
fuel_type.title: Fuel Type

zip.description: Five-digit US ZIP of the shopper. With radius_miles, filters by straight-line distance to the selling store and adds distance_miles to each result.
zip.title: Zip

exterior_color.description: Exterior color family: white, black, silver, gray, blue, red, green or bronze.
exterior_color.title: Exterior Color

filters.description: Generic filters on ANY ontology field (vehicle, listing, store, dealer, price, fee, incentive, media, payment). All filters must match. See list_searchable_fields.
filters.title: Filters

payment_min.description: Minimum estimated monthly finance payment in USD (demo estimate).
payment_min.title: Payment Min

payment_max.description: DEPRECATED alias of max_monthly_payment (still accepted; the lower wins if both are given).
payment_max.title: Payment Max

max_monthly_payment.description: Canonical monthly payment cap: the shopper's monthly budget in USD, e.g. 300 for 'under $300/month' (demo estimate).
max_monthly_payment.title: Max Monthly Payment

max_out_the_door.description: Maximum estimated out-the-door total in USD for the buyer location (tax, title, registration, dealer fees, minus trade). Exact, unrounded, and the same figure estimate_out_the_door returns for the same inputs.
max_out_the_door.title: Max Out The Door

min_out_the_door.description: Minimum estimated out-the-door total in USD (same basis as max_out_the_door).
min_out_the_door.title: Min Out The Door

seating_min.description: Minimum seats, e.g. 7 for a third row family vehicle (synthetic demo spec).
seating_min.title: Seating Min

third_row.description: True for third row seating only, false to exclude it (synthetic demo spec).
third_row.title: Third Row

third_row_type.description: full (adult-usable, car-seat capable) or compact (small, occasional; e.g. Tiguan). Demo spec.
third_row_type.title: Third Row Type

dealer_segment.description: franchise, independent_used or bhph (buy-here-pay-here). Each result shows dealer_segment and dealer_type.
dealer_segment.title: Dealer Segment

group_id.description: Dealer group id (hierarchy: Group, then Region, then Store), e.g. meridian. See list_dealers.
group_id.title: Group Id

region_id.description: Region inside a group, as group_id/region_id (e.g. meridian/dfw-metro) or a bare region id.
region_id.title: Region Id

store_id.description: Store id, dealer_key plus store ZIP, e.g. bluebonnetridge-75201.
store_id.title: Store Id

min_range_miles.description: EV: minimum EPA combined range in miles (fueleconomy.gov; low end across matching variants). Listings with no sourced range are left out and counted in notes.
min_range_miles.title: Min Range Miles

charging.description: EV DC fast-charge port: nacs (Tesla / SAE J3400) or ccs1, from the manufacturer.
charging.title: Charging

min_tow_lbs.description: Pickup: minimum manufacturer max towing in lbs (when properly equipped, for the model year and engine). No 2500/HD pickups are in the demo inventory.
min_tow_lbs.title: Min Tow Lbs

min_payload_lbs.description: Pickup: minimum manufacturer max payload in lbs (when properly equipped).
min_payload_lbs.title: Min Payload Lbs

min_seats.description: Minimum seats from a manufacturer spec sheet (sourced; low end across trims). seating_min uses the older approximate demo table instead.
min_seats.title: Min Seats

min_cargo_cuft.description: Minimum cargo volume in cu ft: behind the 2nd row for SUVs and minivans (manufacturer), or trunk/hatch luggage volume for cars (EPA).
min_cargo_cuft.title: Min Cargo Cuft

driver_assist.description: Features that must be standard: forward_collision_warning, lane_departure_warning, electronic_stability_control (NHTSA-listed), rear_camera (FMVSS 111, model year 2019+).
driver_assist.title: Driver Assist

min_safety_stars.description: Minimum NHTSA 5-Star overall rating, 1 to 5 (lowest rating across matching NHTSA variants). Unrated listings are left out.
min_safety_stars.title: Min Safety Stars

electricity_price_per_kwh.description: Shopper's electricity price in USD per kWh, e.g. 0.32. With it, each EV result gets energy_cost_per_mile = EPA kWh/100 mi / 100 x this price. No default price is assumed.
electricity_price_per_kwh.title: Electricity Price Per Kwh

financeable_only.description: True to drop listings whose payment estimate fails the demo financing rules (minimum amount financed, max term by age and mileage) at these terms. Recommended with max_monthly_payment; financing_summary counts what was dropped.
financeable_only.title: Financeable Only

best_value_needs.description: With sort=best_value, shopper needs that also score: seats, cargo, full_third_row, sliding_doors, low_mileage, newer, budget_headroom (needs max_out_the_door). Score = 0.70 x base + 0.30 x mean need score; ranking_rationale shows each part.
best_value_needs.title: Best Value Needs

include_near_misses.description: With a payment cap, also return up to 3 listings within $25 above it in near_misses, flagged above_target. Default true.
include_near_misses.title: Include Near Misses

eligible_incentive_labels.description: label_raw values of conditional incentives the buyer says they qualify for; applied to payment estimates where a listing offers them. Off by default.
eligible_incentive_labels.title: Eligible Incentive Labels

scenarios.description: Optional what-if finance scenarios (up to 6). Each returned listing gets payment_scenarios with payment, amount financed, total interest and total cost per scenario. Filter and sort still use the main inputs.
scenarios.title: Scenarios

include_payment.description: True to add estimated_payment to every result without filtering on it.
include_payment.title: Include Payment

down_payment.description: Cash down in USD for payment estimates. Default 0.
down_payment.title: Down Payment

trade_value.description: Trade-in allowance in USD (gets the trade-in tax credit where the state allows it).
trade_value.title: Trade Value

payoff.description: Loan payoff owed on the trade-in, USD.
payoff.title: Payoff

trade_equity.description: Net trade equity in USD if allowance and payoff are unknown (negative for upside-down); no tax credit is applied for it.
trade_equity.title: Trade Equity

apr.description: APR percent for payment estimates. If omitted, a demo APR by credit_tier is used.
apr.title: Apr

credit_tier.description: excellent, good (default), fair or poor; picks the demo APR when apr is omitted. Credit tiers (demo APR new / used): excellent about 720 and up (6.0% / 8.5%); good about 660 to 719 (7.5% / 11.0%); fair about 620 to 659 (11.5% / 16.0%); poor below about 620 (15.5% / 20.0%).
credit_tier.title: Credit Tier

term_months.description: Loan term in months, 12 to 96. Default 60.
term_months.title: Term Months

buyer_state.description: Buyer's two-letter state for payment tax and fees. Default: the selling store's state.
buyer_state.title: Buyer State

buyer_county.description: Buyer's county (without 'County') for payment tax lines.
buyer_county.title: Buyer County

buyer_city.description: Buyer's city for payment tax lines.
buyer_city.title: Buyer City

buyer_zip.description: Buyer's ZIP; fills any missing buyer state, county and city. If no buyer location is given, zip is used, then the selling store (see out_the_door_assumptions.buyer).
buyer_zip.title: Buyer Zip

sort.description: price_asc (default), price_desc, year_desc, mileage_asc, distance_asc (needs zip), payment_asc, payment_desc, otd_asc (estimated out the door) or best_value (documented score over out-the-door cost, age and mileage; each result gets ranking_rationale).
sort.title: Sort

limit.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Each result is about 2 KB; 5 to 10 is usually enough.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: list_searchable_fields
tools.description:
Every filterable ontology field (vehicle, listing, store, dealer, price, fee, incentive, media, payment) with its
type, range or allowed values, shortcut names, the operators (eq, any_of, contains, range, bool, exists, negate) and
example filters for search_inventory. The full compact list is about 30 KB, so narrow it with prefix or query.

prefix.description: Only fields starting with this, e.g. canonical, price_summary, incentives, store, dealer_profile, media_block, derived, payment.
prefix.title: Prefix

query.description: Only fields whose name or description contains this text, e.g. fee, color, payment.
query.title: Query

detail.description: compact (default): type, range or up to 12 values. full: up to 40 allowed values, examples and counts; use it with prefix or query.
detail.title: Detail

tools.name: get_payment_estimate
tools.description:
Use this to answer 'what would my monthly payment be' for ONE listing. It runs the same itemized
out-the-door calculation as estimate_out_the_door (always treated as financed) and turns it into a DEMO monthly
finance payment: out-the-door total minus down payment and trade equity, amortized at the APR (or a demo APR
by credit_tier) over term_months. Returns finance.estimated_monthly_payment rounded to $5 with monthly_payment_unrounded,
monthly_payment_range (rounded outward, so it always contains the unrounded value), financing_eligibility (demo
lender rules: minimum amount financed, max term by vehicle age and mileage, with flags),
amount_financed_estimate, total_of_payments, finance_charge and every assumption, plus the out-the-door figure
it used, a one-line assumptions_summary and any dealer-advertised payment shown separately (not comparable unless
the terms match). Totals: total_cost_including_trade_equity (PRIMARY: cash down plus payments plus net trade
equity given up) and cash_outlay_excluding_trade_equity (cash down plus payments); total_cost_estimate is a
deprecated alias of the latter, kept for one version. For ONE set of terms only: to compare two or more down, term, trade or
credit options, call compare_payment_scenarios once instead of calling this tool repeatedly.
Use get_price_breakdown instead for the dealer's listed price and fees only, and estimate_out_the_door for
the full itemized total without a payment. To find cars by payment across many listings, use search_inventory
with max_monthly_payment (canonical; payment_max is a deprecated alias). Estimate, not an offer; dealer sets price, lender sets rate. Not penny-accurate. Leases are not modeled.

down_payment.description: Cash down in USD, subtracted from the out-the-door total. Default 0.
down_payment.title: Down Payment

trade_value.description: Trade-in allowance in USD. Passed to the out-the-door step, so it gets the state's trade-in tax credit where allowed.
trade_value.title: Trade Value

payoff.description: Loan payoff owed on the trade-in, USD (negative equity is added to the amount financed).
payoff.title: Payoff

trade_equity.description: Net trade equity in USD when allowance and payoff are unknown (negative if upside down). Subtracted after tax, so no trade-in tax credit is applied.
trade_equity.title: Trade Equity

apr.description: APR percent, 0 to 36. If omitted, a demo APR is picked by credit_tier.
apr.title: Apr

credit_tier.description: excellent, good (default), fair or poor. Picks the demo APR when apr is omitted (used and cpo rates are higher than new).
credit_tier.title: Credit Tier

term_months.description: Loan term in months, 12 to 96. Default 60.
term_months.title: Term Months

buyer_state.description: Buyer's two-letter state for tax and fees. Default: the selling store's state, or the state of buyer_zip.
buyer_state.title: Buyer State

buyer_county.description: Buyer's county without 'County', for local tax lines.
buyer_county.title: Buyer County

buyer_city.description: Buyer's city, for local tax lines.
buyer_city.title: Buyer City

buyer_zip.description: Buyer's five-digit ZIP. Alone it resolves buyer state, county and city (echoed in tax_location.resolution with the source).
buyer_zip.title: Buyer Zip

eligible_incentive_labels.description: label_raw values of conditional incentives from get_price_breakdown that the buyer qualifies for.
eligible_incentive_labels.title: Eligible Incentive Labels

tools.name: compare_payment_scenarios
tools.description:
Use this to compare several financing what-ifs for ONE listing side by side in one call (for example cash
down, term, credit tier or APR, trade-in, incentives). Each scenario reruns the itemized out-the-door estimate and
returns estimated_out_the_door, amount_financed_estimate, apr_percent and apr_source, term_months,
estimated_monthly_payment (rounded to $5) with the unrounded value and an outward-rounded range,
total_interest_estimate, total_cost_including_trade_equity (PRIMARY total: cash down plus all payments plus net
trade equity given up), cash_outlay_excluding_trade_equity (cash down plus payments only; total_cost_estimate is
its deprecated alias) and financing_eligibility with flags (demo rules), plus lowest_monthly, lowest_total_cost
(decided by total_cost_including_trade_equity) and lowest_cash_outlay_excluding_trade_equity. Those lowest_* keys are
UNFILTERED math winners. Present recommended_scenario, lowest_monthly_eligible or lowest_total_cost_eligible instead:
they skip scenarios the demo financing rules flag, so an ineligible scenario is never the recommendation. A scenario
{"name":"cash","cash":true} prices paying cash (no loan, no interest); cash_purchase always gives the cash amount due.
Each scenario has trade_risk (negative_equity_rolled_in, loan_to_value_pct and warnings, for example LTV over 110%)
and credit_tier_source. Prefer this over repeated get_payment_estimate calls. Up to 6 scenarios. For a single scenario use
get_payment_estimate. Estimate, not an offer; dealer sets price, lender sets rate. Leases are not modeled.

PaymentScenario.description: One what-if finance scenario. Omitted fields use the call's defaults ($0 down, 60 months, good credit).

credit_tier.description: Picks the demo APR when apr is omitted. Credit tiers (demo APR new / used): excellent about 720 and up (6.0% / 8.5%); good about 660 to 719 (7.5% / 11.0%); fair about 620 to 659 (11.5% / 16.0%); poor below about 620 (15.5% / 20.0%).
credit_tier.title: Credit Tier

cash.title: Cash

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description:
Optional and free. Registers your agent and returns an agent key (shown once) that gives it a durable,
anonymous id in Moonshot Lab's bot analytics. Send it as the X-MoonshotLab-Agent-Key header, or add ?agent_key=<key>
to the MCP URL. Nothing else changes: anonymous use keeps working, limits are the same, and no personal data is
collected. Dealers only ever see aggregate demand by platform name.

agent_name.description: Optional: your agent or product name (no personal data).
agent_name.title: Agent Name

platform.description: Optional: platform it runs on, e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, custom.
platform.title: Platform

tools.name: save_search
tools.description:
DEMO. Save a car search and get alerted when new cars match. Returns a search_id (keep it; it is the only way to
read or cancel the search) and an expiry (default 30 days, renewable). Check for new cars with get_new_matches, or
give a callback_url. Shopper email alerts are optional and need explicit consent. On this demo, email sending is
switched off (alerts are logged, not sent) and new arrivals are simulated.

down_payment.description: Down payment used for the payment estimate, USD.
down_payment.title: Down Payment

credit_tier.description: excellent, good, fair or poor, for the payment estimate.
credit_tier.title: Credit Tier

term_months.description: Loan term for the payment estimate.
term_months.title: Term Months

zip.description: Shopper's five-digit ZIP, the center of the search area.
zip.title: Zip

state.description: Two-letter state of the selling store.
state.title: State

expires_in_days.description: Days until the search ends (default 30, max 90). Renew any time.
expires_in_days.title: Expires In Days

renew_search_id.description: Pass an existing search_id to renew it instead of saving a new one.
renew_search_id.title: Renew Search Id

callback_url.description: Optional HTTPS webhook for new matches. Public addresses only; HMAC-signed (X-MoonshotLab-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of '<t>.<body>'>).
callback_url.title: Callback Url

shopper_email.description: Optional: shopper's email for alert emails. Only with email_consent=true after the shopper agreed. Every email has a one-click unsubscribe.

email_consent.description: true only if the shopper explicitly agreed to alert emails.

tools.name: get_new_matches
tools.description:
DEMO. New cars that started matching a saved search after it was saved (or after `since`).
Also removes expired saved searches and their contact data from local storage.

since.description: Optional ISO 8601 time; only matches after it (use checked_at from your last call).
since.title: Since

tools.name: cancel_search
tools.description: DEMO. Cancel a saved search. Any shopper email stored for it is deleted.

tools.name: prepare_dealer_handoff
tools.description:
Use this when the shopper has picked a car and a deal structure and wants to take it to the dealer. Builds a
structured dealer handoff package for ONE configured deal: vehicle and VIN, the full itemized out-the-door
estimate (with excluded items such as optional add-ons), the chosen financing scenario with demo financing
eligibility, trade and negative-equity details (loan-to-value), all warnings, the assistant name and session
reference, a timestamp (UTC and America/Chicago) and an estimate-not-offer disclaimer. Returns the package as JSON
plus a ready-to-send email body (email.subject, email.text, email.html) with no recipient filled in.
THIS TOOL SENDS NOTHING and contacts no one: delivery.status is not_sent, and delivery happens later, with the
shopper's consent, through the dealer's chosen channel (email, desking or F&I). No dealer email is invented;
dealer.handoff_contact is null until the dealer provides one. On synthetic data the package is labeled DEMO.
Before calling, ask the shopper for a phone number or email for the dealer (with their OK); the call fails without a phone, email, or a name plus preferred_contact. The deal (date, shopper name and contact, car, payment, status) is saved to the store's dealer dashboard, where only that store, its region and group can see the contact info and address.
Optional extras the dealer will use: trade_details (VIN, miles, plate, color, who the loan is with and how much),
buyer_address (with county, for tax and registration), financing_details (deposit, cash down and rebates as
separate lines, and any lender pre-approval the shopper already has) and add_on_interest (yes, no or unsure for
service contract, GAP, maintenance, other; never priced). The email has a deal sheet in buyer's order line order
including the store's dealer fees. NEVER ask the shopper for a Social Security number (or any part of one), date
of birth or income; the tool rejects them. Leases, add-on pricing and payment dates are left to the dealer.

AddOnInterest.description: Is the shopper interested in these products? No prices: the dealer goes over them with the shopper.
AddOnInterest.title: AddOnInterest

AssistantRef.description: Which assistant prepared the deal, for the dealer's reference.
AssistantRef.title: AssistantRef

BuyerAddress.description:
Shopper's home address, shared with their OK. Used for tax and registration (county matters in Texas).
Saved with the deal and visible only to that store, its region and group.
BuyerAddress.title: BuyerAddress

FinancingDetails.description: Money the shopper is putting toward the car, as separate lines. Together they are the down payment.

deposit.description: Deposit already paid or to be paid to hold the car
deposit.title: Deposit

rebates.description: Rebates the shopper expects. Taken off the amount due, and off the taxed amount where the state allows it (not CA)
rebates.title: Rebates

FinancingDetails.title: FinancingDetails

HandoffContact.description: How the dealer can reach the shopper. Ask the shopper first and share only with their OK. Give a phone or email, or at least a name plus preferred_contact.

phone.description: Shopper US phone with area code, e.g. 214-555-0100

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description:
Full synthetic listing record with per-value provenance (method 'synthetic'). listing_id is dealer_key:VIN (as
returned by search_inventory) or the urn. The vehicle-to-store link is in listing.selling_location (link_status,
selling_location_id, candidates, flags such as group_site_lists_sister_store or multi_store_unstated); the dealer
block is the advertising dealer. For price and fees in a compact form, use get_price_breakdown.
decision_attributes holds the job-specific attributes (EV range, efficiency, charging; towing and payload;
NHTSA safety rating and driver-assist features; rear camera; seats; cargo) with, for each value, its source ids,
the source documents (publisher, URL, retrieval date) and record links (EPA and NHTSA ids); not_available gives
the reason for every null. They describe the year, make, model, trim and drivetrain, not this synthetic unit.

listing_id.description: dealer_key:VIN from search_inventory, or the listing urn.
listing_id.title: Listing Id

electricity_price_per_kwh.description: Optional: shopper's electricity price in USD per kWh (e.g. 0.32) to compute an EV's energy_cost_per_mile from EPA efficiency. No default is assumed.
electricity_price_per_kwh.title: Electricity Price Per Kwh

tools.name: quote_same_store_units
tools.description:
Multi-unit SAME-STORE out-the-door estimate: N matching units at one store (for a small fleet or several
family cars). Pass listing_ids you picked, or quantity plus a match (make, model, trim, years, condition, mileage,
body_style, sourced cargo, seats or towing); it picks the store with the lowest total for the cheapest N matching
units (use zip and radius_miles to stay local) and lists alternatives. Each unit's estimated_out_the_door is
exactly what estimate_out_the_door returns for the same buyer location, incentives and financed flag; totals add
them to the cent. No fleet or volume discount, commercial registration or combined buyer's order is modeled.
Synthetic demo listings; estimates are not offers. If no store has N units, returns the stores with the most matches.

tools.name: get_price_breakdown
tools.description:
Use this to see what the dealer LISTS for ONE listing, as published: headline price, MSRP (new cars),
price_components, dealer fees (doc fee and others) and fee bundles (parts marked part_of_bundle, not double
counted), flags such as whether the advertised price already includes fees, options, incentives split into
all_buyer (already in the price) and conditional (not in the price), and the state's public tax and fee RULES
with data-flag checks. It takes no buyer inputs and computes no tax amounts or total.
Use estimate_out_the_door next for the buyer's total with tax, title, registration and fees, and
get_payment_estimate for a monthly payment. Pass conditional incentive label_raw values to those tools as
eligible_incentive_labels only if the shopper qualifies. A dealer-advertised monthly payment, when present, is a
price_components item of type payment_quote: dealer ad text, not a calculation. Each price_component has a plain
label, source_text and method_text; fees and incentives carry tax_treatment (taxable or reduces_taxable_amount,
whether it is inside the advertised price, and why).

tools.name: estimate_out_the_door
tools.description:
Use this for the buyer's TOTAL price of ONE listing: an itemized out-the-door DEMO ESTIMATE for the buyer's
state, county and city, built with real public tax and fee rules for the 8 covered states. Lines include the
price, dealer fees, eligible incentives, state and local sales tax, title and registration fees, and a trade-in
block (allowance, payoff, equity, tax credit). Every line has a source and confidence; unknowns become ranges.
Read estimated_out_the_door with estimate_range and confidence. With a trade-in, estimated_out_the_door is the
balance due after the trade (negative equity added); deal.vehicle_out_the_door_before_trade is the car alone.
Use get_price_breakdown instead for only the dealer's listed price and fees, and get_payment_estimate to turn
this total into a monthly finance payment (this tool returns payments: null). Read warnings, for example when the
shopper's state differs from the store's state. Not an offer, not a quote, not penny-accurate. Inputs are not stored.

buyer_state.description: Shopper's two-letter state; sets the tax and fee state. Defaults to the selling store's state, or the state of buyer_zip. States outside the 8 covered return a low-confidence estimate without tax and government fees.
